title: 800+ Google Fonts Pack
text:
## 800+ Google Fonts Pack
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000077832

## Overview
Want to give the website a unique and custom look to match the rest of the branding? The Google Fonts Pack provides over 800 fonts to choose from when designing the site.
Mix and match multiple fonts to use around the site to make a lasting impression with website visitors. As Google adds more fonts to their library the choice of fonts will continue to grow!

## Using the Add-On
There are different places within the Design Settings that the Google Fonts Pack can be used:
1. Go to Settings - Design Settings:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174859214/original/Joemy3Z-pZkioLmjCC5PPOmFMqWGR-uPGg.png?1771428624 | alt: ]
2. Search for the keyword "font", and all the places this can be used will show up:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174859355/original/1iDkBWf7AIwcQl4VUAZqj_XNCULgwrAPzA.png?1771428749 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174859424/original/OO9090oZozHvxQ_EhyQsjA7wH1l2Qy3eoA.png?1771428785 | alt: ]
